tools.name: thaiprops_search_properties
tools.description:
Search live published ThaiProps listings across Thailand using natural language.

    Use this for requests such as "pet friendly 2 bedroom condo near Ekkamai BTS
    under 55,000 baht", "house for sale in Phuket with pool", or other Thailand
    property requirements. ThaiProps AI Search interprets

tools.name: thaiprops_get_property
tools.description: Get public details for one published ThaiProps property by numeric property ID.

tools.name: thaiprops_get_project
tools.description: Get public details for one published ThaiProps real-estate project by numeric project ID.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Standard read-only search tool for AI hosts that expect search/fetch semantics.

    Searches live ThaiProps Thailand property inventory and returns concise,
    citable result records with IDs and absolute URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Standard read-only fetch tool.

    Accepts IDs returned by search, such as property:713266 or project:964576.
    A plain numeric ID is treated as a ThaiProps property ID.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "thaiprops_search_properties" is 1034 chars, far longer than this server's median (177). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
